definitions.gloss: gathering brushwood; cutting small wood for fuel
definitions.explanation: Going into the hills to cut brushwood and twigs for fuel, a routine chore in rural Japan before gas and electricity. Now known mainly from folktales.

examples.japanese: おじいさんは⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{柴刈|しばか}りに⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The old man went to the mountains to gather firewood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{柴刈|しばか}りは⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧どもの⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧でもあった。
examples.english: On farms in the old days, gathering brushwood was also a job for children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桃太郎|ももたろう}→桃太郎：30946_momotarou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「{柴刈|しばか}り」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧ことだと⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I used to think the しばかり in Momotarō meant mowing the lawn.

notes:
Best known from the opening of the Momotarō story: おじいさんは⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{柴刈|しばか}りに、おばあさんは⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. {柴|しば} is brushwood, the small trees and branches gathered for fuel.

WATCH OUT:
Not ⟦{芝刈|しばか}り→芝刈り：08532_shibakari⟧ (lawn mowing). The two are pronounced the same, and learners and children alike often picture the old man mowing grass.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{芝刈|しばか}り→芝刈り：08532_shibakari⟧: lawn mowing
- ⟦{薪|まき}→薪：14118_maki⟧: firewood (split logs)
